commentary.text: 90+10' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+10' Luis Milla (Getafe) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
90+10' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Getafe win a corner.
90+5' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jordi will be replaced by Fabrizio Angileri (Getafe).
90+2' Betis have been awarded a corner kick.
90+2' Nabil Fekir (Betis) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Betis.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
89' The referee cannot ignore such behaviour. Rui Silva (Betis) sees a yellow card and needs to watch himself for the rest of the game.
89' Getafe are ruled offside.
88' Getafe force a corner. They send men into the box.
88' Luis Milla (Getafe) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

87' Well-positioned Mason Greenwood (Getafe) was first to the rebound and fired in a shot towards the right post, but Rui Silva reacted superbly to keep the ball out. The fans could not believe their eyes. It was a miraculous stop!
82' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with William Carvalho (Betis) replacing Isco.
81' It doesn’t look good for Isco (Betis); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!

70' Substitution. Jaime Mata did his best and is replaced by Carles Alena (Getafe).
70' Jose Bordalas Jimenez decides to make a substitution. Yellu Santiago will be replaced by Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe).

62' Yellu Santiago (Getafe) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
61' Diego Rico (Getafe) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

49' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Getafe.
47' Rodri (Betis) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!

45+1' Nabil Fekir (Betis) takes a mid-range free kick, but his miskick goes way wide to the right. Poor shot! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
45' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.

43' Isco (Betis) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
41' The game has begun to heat up. Assane Diao (Betis) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
40' Juan Pulido shows a yellow card to Juan Miranda (Betis) for his blatant foul.
40' PENALTY APPEAL after Mason Greenwood (Getafe) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
39' The Getafe players are exchanging some short passes.
35' 1 - 1 Goal! Isco (Betis) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past David Soria into the bottom left corner.

34' It’s a PENALTY to Betis after the VAR review!
34' Play continues despite the shouts by some Betis players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Juan Pulido interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
33' One of the Betis players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
33' Isco (Betis) will take a corner kick.

29' Jaime Mata (Getafe) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Juan Pulido with no other option than to blow for a foul.
27' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Betis was in an offside position.
23' One of the players from Getafe times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
23' Jaime Mata (Getafe) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the left post!
21' Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Juan Pulido blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
19' Sokratis (Betis) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
16' Neat passing move from Betis in order to create new attacking opportunities.
13' Abner is substituted due to injury. Manuel Pellegrini gives a chance to Juan Miranda (Betis).
11' Abner (Betis) looks like he won’t be able to continue.

7' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) is going to take the penalty!
